newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Leumi in financina for Indonesian bank.
newsitem.headline: Leumi in financina for Indonesian bank.

text.p: Israel's Bank Leumi said on Wednesday it signed an agreement to participate in an $80 million syndicated loan for Bank Dagang Nacional Indonesia.
Among the banks involved in the financing deal are Bank Iseseuschaft Berlin, BNP, ING and Banca di Roma as well as Arab Investment Co and Bank of Bahrain & Kuwait.
Leumi said that as far as it knew this was the first time an Israeli bank was invited to participate in a financing agreement for an Indonesian bank.

Israel and Indonesia do not have diplomatic ties but the late Israeli Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin made an official visit to Jakarta in 1993. Jakarta has said it will not open diplomatic links with Israel until a comprehensive solution to the Middle East problem is achieved.
